user.title: NikaS HO-SC-8W Irrigation
user.description: Connect an INKBIRD / HiOazo HO-SC-8W. Local Tuya v3.3 is the primary transport. Remove any other integration that keeps a persistent local connection to this controller before setup.

reconfigure_local.title: Update local connection
reconfigure_local.description: The new Local Key and IP are verified with a read-only status request before they are saved.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Update Tuya Cloud credentials
reconfigure_cloud.description: Credentials are verified by a read-only cloud status request before they are saved.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to HO-SC-8W. Check IP, Device ID and Local Key. Ensure no other integration holds the device's local Tuya connection.
error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot verify the HO-SC-8W local connection. Existing configuration was not changed.
error.cannot_prepare_local: Cannot safely stop the active local listener for verification. Existing configuration was not changed.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection details were verified, saved and reloaded.

start_manual_queue.name: Start manual irrigation queue
start_manual_queue.description: Starts zones 1–6 sequentially with individual durations and verifies controller read-back.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Required only when multiple HO-SC-8W controllers are loaded.

zones.name: Zone queue
zones.description: List of objects containing zone and duration_minutes.

stop_manual.name: Stop manual irrigation
stop_manual.description: Sets the controller to OFF and verifies that no zones are active or queued.

resume_automatic.name: Resume automatic mode
resume_automatic.description: Sets an idle controller to Auto and verifies DP101.

set_seasonal_adjustment.name: Set seasonal adjustment
set_seasonal_adjustment.description: Writes DP103 in 10% steps and verifies the same value by read-back.

set_zone8_schedule_field.name: Set one Zone 8 schedule field
set_zone8_schedule_field.description: Laboratory DP38 write for Zone 8 only, followed by exact controller read-back.

restore_zone8_schedule.name: Restore Zone 8 schedule
restore_zone8_schedule.description: Restores the exact Zone 8 block saved before the first laboratory change.
